about: What Plaid's test bank (sandbox) really sent on Oct 7, 2026, for a test user with made-up accounts shaped like his, saved as it came (API version 2020-09-14): the first sync with the history, then a sync after ten test transactions were added. The keys that open the connection were never saved. The ids are the test bank's own; every name and number is made up. The test bank does not move balances when transactions are added (Plaid: Sandbox transaction history may show income and outflow inconsistent with the balance shown on the account).

stages.name: the first sync, with the history
